scope_limitations: All existing project history is retrospective and current-deployability intersection has survivorship bias
No leader labels, copied live account, source strategy state or production service is imported
No simultaneous long and short on one pair in native Freqtrade; no full Omofun hedge/grid replication claim
Historical public-flow panel is only an economic research input; a validated current-bar feed is required before paper/live eligibility
numerical_storage: float64 public archive flow/ranks; finite trailing14bar simple-average true-range; no recursive feature state

frequency_screen.definition: whole native closed trades divided by all UTC calendar days; funded candidate retains minimum30whole trades and10percent maximum observed drawdown

factor_definition.source_adaptations: 3minute public flow becomes archived5minute flow; crypto-only40 instead of original larger crypto/TradFi population; no positioning data synthesized
factor_definition.entry: volume rank>=.9, liquidity rank>=.5; top20m return decile/residual>0/flow>0 long, bottom decile/residual<0/flow<0 short; rising direction edges, one highest volume-rank then absolute residual then symbol perbar

account.initial_stop: 2*14bar simple-average true-range, fixed at filled entry; reject distance>=5percent;5percent native fallback

variants.PerpFlowFast: full1percent price-profit harvest, loss of residual or flow confirmation,60minute cap or fixedATRstop; no additions
variants.PerpFlowFunded: same seed and risk; one half-size exit at1percent priceprofit; one addition only after actual net-positive realized profit including native fees/funding, still-current direction confirmation, added stop-risk bounded by realized profit, added stake<=half initial; maximum2entries and1partial harvest; full2percentprofit or original confirmation/time/ATR exits
